title: Canonical weak convergence maps from finite diagonal tails
statement: For any regular limiting subobjects of the canonical cycle-boundary tower, the finite diagonal tail hypotheses imply the canonical weak convergence predicate.

proof.text: Use the finite diagonal tail bounds to propagate isomorphisms and zero terms through the canonical derived-couple recursion, then form stationary greatest-lower-bound and least-upper-bound subobjects.

mathlib_searches.query: finite exact couple stationary cycles weak convergence
mathlib_searches.results: No matching declaration; only generic homological exactness.

lean.statement: theorem finiteCocone_weakMaps {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] (X : BigradedExactCouple C 0) (A : ∀ n : ℤ, X.AlphaColimit n) (hA : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ a b : ℤ, (∀ P : ℤ, P ≤ a → IsIso ((A n).ι P)) ∧ (∀ P : ℤ, b ≤ P → IsZero (X.D P (n - P)))) (L : X.LimitSubobjects) (hreg : X.IsRegular) : X.WeaklyConvergesTo L A
